diagnostics.message: `local_file.halconfig` interpolates `local.aws.id` and `local.aws.region` into its `content` template. Those locals are defined in defaults.tf as `module.aws.caller.account_id` and `module.aws.region.name`, so the rendered halconfig script genuinely needs the `aws-partitions` module to resolve first. However, because the reference is routed through a `locals` value, the graph shows `local_file.halconfig` depending only on `module.devops` and `var.features`, with no edge to `module.aws` — the ordering is not captured. Reference `module.aws` directly in the resource so Terraform infers the dependency.
